snippet.title: Fortnite Festival - Mixtape Music Pass Live Now!
snippet.description:
Stack your setlists with the Mixtape Music Pass: our biggest, most varied collection of Jam Tracks yet!

Start building up that catalog because soon, you'll be able to press play on your favorite Jam Tracks in even more ways in Fortnite 👀🎧
